La RM con contrasto è l'esame più sensib:
Contrast-enhanced MRI is the most sensitive examination for the extent of breast cancer: it measures the tumor, finds other foci in the same and the contralateral breast and assesses the relationship with the pectoral muscle and the chest wall.
For a mass, shape, margins and internal enhancement (homogeneous, heterogeneous, rim) are described, together with the curve over time: type 1 persistent, type 2 plateau, type 3 washout. Irregular shape, spiculated or irregular margins, rim enhancement, plateau and washout are suspicious.
Triple-negative carcinomas are often masses with rim enhancement and a necrotic center, sometimes hyperintense on T2, with partly sharp margins that may look benign. They grow fast and treatment often starts with neoadjuvant chemotherapy: the baseline MRI is used to measure the response.
BI-RADS 6 indicates a tumor already proven by biopsy.
RM di stadiazione: misura il tumore noto: Staging MRI: measure the known tumor, then look for everything else (same breast, contralateral breast, lymph nodes).
